pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

One of the biggest entertainment IPs in history, 30th anniversary underway, McDonald’s collabs through 2027, and a massive untapped audience as Pump pushes mainstream adoption.

6,300+ holders, paired with $CARDS, 100% of creator rewards allocated to holders, and sitting 97% below ATH.

The upside imo is absurd if that attention converts into demand.

Pokémon has a massive, established fanbase and consistently finds its way back into mainstream attention. That gives this token a recognizable narrative with recurring opportunities to attract new buyers (pump pushing referrals and onboarding)

In the last 18 hours alone, “Pokémon McDonald’s Happy Meal” has been one of the top rising Google searches, up over 200% (and confirmed for Nov 10th in US). IMO this is great because between new releases, collaborations, nostalgia, etc. Pokémon isn’t a trend that relies on a single moment.

A lot of people joining the app already know, collect, or play Pokémon, making this an easy narrative to understand and get into.

It passes LarpCheck, and I see more reasons for upside than downside at these levels, so I’ll keep accumulating on dips. Any acknowledgment from Pokémon itself would just be an insane bonus.

The bet is that Pokémon’s recurring cultural relevance can translate into recurring attention and demand for the token long term. Also - down 96% from ATH
